name: Geetas Gyan

visual_style: in the style of a Raja Ravi Varma oil painting, traditional Indian devotional art, divine soft golden light, rich saffron blue and gold palette, serene, ultra detailed, cinematic vertical composition, no text, no watermark

characters.KRISHNA: Lord Krishna as a handsome young man, masculine face, deep blue skin, black curly hair, tall golden crown with a peacock feather, fully dressed in a yellow silk pitambar and angavastram, gold jewellery and vaijayanti garland, gentle knowing smile, golden halo, holding a bansuri flute
